brief.headline: Azov tanker losses and Moscow assassination-plot bust dominate
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels balanced upbeat frontline and FSB counterintelligence messaging against rare acknowledgment of Ukrainian long-range strikes, with claims that drones hit 35 shadow-fleet tankers in the Azov Sea. US strikes on Iran ran as a parallel geopolitical story across the same channels.

developments.title: Channels concede Ukrainian drones hit 35 Azov Sea tankers
developments.body: Two Majors and Rybar reported a 96-hour Ukrainian drone campaign against Russian 'shadow fleet' tankers in the Sea of Azov, claiming 35 vessels struck and the Black Sea Fleet confined to port; Two Majors said 20+ drones were downed. Unconfirmed and unusually negative framing for these outlets.

developments.title: FSB assassination-plot bust heavily amplified across channels
developments.body: Rybar, Kotsnews, Poddubny and WarGonzo all reported the FSB thwarting an alleged SBU plot to kill a Russian Defense Ministry officer in Moscow with an explosives-laden drone; a 25-year-old woman was said to be detained. All claims are FSB-sourced.

developments.title: Claimed Russian advances around Konstantinovka, Liman, Kupyansk
developments.body: Rybar claimed captures in Kharkiv region and progress toward Pokrovsk, plus clearing of Konstantinovka and Liman; Poddubny said forces are advancing toward Slavyansk-Kramatorsk after Konstantinovka's 'liberation'. WarGonzo cited gains on Zaporizhzhia/Donetsk fronts. Unconfirmed and MoD-aligned.

developments.title: Alarm over Ukraine's expanding long-range strike arsenal
developments.body: Rybar flagged Ukraine's FP-9 ballistic missile tests, Flamingo cruise missile output rising to 90 units with European support, and 2,500km+ drones reaching the Omsk refinery — framing a growing threat tied to intensified NATO pressure. WarGonzo also reported a HIMARS strike killing a civilian in Bryansk region.

developments.title: US strikes on Iran run as major parallel story
developments.body: Rybar, Kotsnews, WarGonzo and Poddubny reported US strikes on 90-170+ Iranian military targets near the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian retaliation against US bases, and a framing that Washington seeks to isolate Iran from Russia and China. Neutral-to-negative tone, largely reposted claims.

developments.title: Lavrov signals distrust of Western peace proposals
developments.body: Poddubny cited Lavrov saying Russia no longer trusts Western peace offers, that 'ultimatums have exhausted trust'. Two Majors framed a Trump-Zelensky meeting as US backing for Ukrainian refinery strikes to force negotiations. Diplomatic-track pessimism dominant.

narrative_watch.title: Ukrainian draft resistance framed as societal collapse
narrative_watch.body: WarGonzo and Kotsnews pushed 'riots in Lviv' and growing unrest against forced mobilization, positioning Ukrainian home-front breakdown as a recurring morale theme.

narrative_watch.title: FSB counterintelligence wins as reassurance content
narrative_watch.body: The saturation of assassination/sabotage-foiled stories serves as domestic reassurance, offsetting negative strike news by emphasizing internal security competence.

narrative_watch.title: Ethnic-nationalist framing on diaspora crime
narrative_watch.body: Rybar amplified the revocation of an Azerbaijani diaspora leader's Russian citizenship over 'criminal ties', a frame worth tracking amid Russia-Azerbaijan tensions.

mood_lines.text: Strongly positive (net +78); channels tout Geran, Lancet and FPV strikes on Ukrainian logistics, fuel infrastructure and river crossings.
Upbeat (net +76) on claimed advances near Konstantinovka, Liman, Kupyansk; occasional admissions of Ukrainian drone-logistics improvements.
Uniformly negative (net -100); Azov tanker losses, Omsk refinery hits and new Ukrainian missiles drive rare defensive tone.
Still negative (net -44) but eased 27 points; Iran-strikes coverage and Patriot-production skepticism dilute pure NATO grievance.
Positive (net +77, up 31); FSB busts and new Su-30SM2/Su-34M deliveries dominate, though Krasnodar fuel shortages noted.
Minimal; single post targeting Lithuanian officials rather than domestic Russian leadership.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO sentiment eases 27 points
flag_texts.body: Net sentiment rose to -44 as coverage shifted from pure grievance toward neutral reporting of US strikes on Iran and skepticism about Ukraine's Patriot/Taurus supply, softening the negative baseline.

flag_texts.title: Russia internal jumps 31 points to +77
flag_texts.body: A cluster of FSB counterintelligence 'wins' — foiled Moscow assassination plots and sabotage arrests — plus new Su-30SM2/Su-34M aircraft deliveries drove strongly positive domestic messaging.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation and Putin-criticism watchlist quiet
flag_texts.body: No substantive posts on Russian mobilisation rumours or criticism of Putin; mobilisation framing was directed entirely at Ukraine's draft, and the day's only criticism post targeted Lithuania.
